item.title: Scott set to lead Lady Jays, who open basketball season vs. Camdenton | Jefferson City News-Tribune
item.description: As the Jefferson City Lady Jays enter Year 1 under the direction of new coach Morgan Scott, the talent and experience are not concerns. The Lady Jays return three starters and eight rotation players, but adjusting to a third system in three seasons marks the biggest challenge for the group headed into the season, which begins tonight with a home Central Missouri Activities Conference matchup against Camdenton.

item.title: Missouri men's basketball rolls to 102-41 victory against Alcorn State | Jefferson City News-Tribune
item.description: The Missouri Tigers scored the game’s first 15 points Wednesday night and ran away with a 102-41 victory against the Alcorn State Braves at Mizzou Arena. Bryson Tiller opened the game with a fast-break dunk, and Jason Crowe Jr. capped off the 15-0 game-opening run with a 3-pointer just less than three minutes in.

item.title: Lincoln women's basketball to take on Central Missouri | Jefferson City News-Tribune
item.description: The Lincoln Blue Tigers women’s basketball team plays former MIAA foe Central Missouri Jennies this morning in Warrensburg. The Blue Tigers and Jennies are meeting for the 71st on the hardwood in today’s 11:30 a.m. tip-off. Central Missouri leads the all-time series 67-3. This is the first meeting between the two long-time foes since 2024, a game in which Central Missouri won 89-56.

item.title: Helias, Jefferson City combine for six AVCA all-region volleyball players | Jefferson City News-Tribune
item.description: The Helias Lady Crusaders and the Jefferson City Lady Jays combined to have six players selected to the American Volleyball Coaches Association’s all-region team, which was announced earlier this month. Missouri is part of the AVCA’s Region 6, which also includes Iowa, Illinois and Wisconsin. Missouri had a total of 30 all-region players.

item.title: Mariners acquire Garcia from Royals in six-player deal | Jefferson City News-Tribune
item.description: The Seattle Mariners acquired Gold Glove third baseman Maikel Garcia from the Kansas City Royals in a six-player trade Wednesday. Right-hander Bryce Miller is one of three major league pitchers going to the Royals. Right-handed starter Logan Evans and left-handed reliever Jose A. Ferrer also are headed to Kansas City, while Seattle receives right-handed reliever James McArthur and minor league right-hander L.P. Langevin.
